headline: Moody's: New upgrade for the Municipality of Athens – "Another recognition of the important work we are doing" says Doukas
summary: Moody's has upgraded the outlook for the Municipality of Athens. The mayor described the upgrade as recognition of the municipality's work and a positive step for its financial image.
why: Credit rating agencies such as Moody's assess the creditworthiness of sub-sovereign issuers, which affects their borrowing costs. Outlook changes signal the direction of a future rating.
